# Go codegen for $"..." translatable strings: lib.GetTranslator() wiring.

sngl compile --platform=bubbletea --lang=go --out=out app.sngl
exists out/model.go

# lib package is imported with the alias "lib".
grep 'lib "git.duckfam.us/jonathan/sngl/lib"' out/model.go

# Static string $"Login" compiles to lib.GetTranslator().Tr with key == inlinedTemplate.
grep 'GetTranslator\(\)\.Tr\("Login", "Login",' out/model.go

# Empty args map is emitted for static strings with no placeholders.
grep 'map\[string\]any{}' out/model.go

# Translatable string with placeholder: args map contains the placeholder binding.
grep '"Hello, \{user\}!"' out/model.go
grep '"user":' out/model.go

-- app.sngl --
output { go { bubbletea } }

component main {
    var greeting = $"Login"
    var user = "alice"
    var hello = $"Hello, {user}!"
    text(value=greeting)
    text(value=hello)
}
